fixture_profile.population: For each named signal, one complete current eligible alternative suffices. Replacing a failed declared source requires distinct independently established source/control/failure group. Denominator must be positive and declared coverage complete. Values are already authenticated and normalized under the fixture profile, except explicit negative context.
fixture_profile.factor: Fixture max over complete required signal subset; this reproduces published boundaries without adding a universal aggregation or A/E formula. No factor weighting is altered.
fixture_profile.scope: Only the named factor/signals are evaluated. Unmentioned ordinary authorization prerequisites are not permission. Soul stops later evaluation; no uncomputed result is filled.
fixture_profile.time: Milliseconds on one authenticated clock; positive threshold accepts equality; zero threshold requires a current-evaluation fresh response.
fixture_profile.independence: The booleans model independently supplied trust context, not candidate assertions or real independence proof.
fixture_profile.given_expected: Modeled inputs/results, not a new collection envelope; result objects use evidence-state.json. Undefined entries preserve exactly input/layer/state, ordered feed/signal/term/query then input.

evidence_limits: Fixed modeled propagation and shape cases, not sensor truth, trusted clocks, actual source independence, real population completeness, enforcement or sensor-stack interoperability. No estimator profile exists. decision_stress and capacityKnown are restrictive evaluation metadata, not fabricated observations.
